newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MGTS mandates CSFB, Salomon for Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: MGTS mandates CSFB, Salomon for Eurobond.

text.p: Moscow telephone company MGTS has mandated international investment banks CS First Boston and Salomon Brothers to lead-manage its debut Eurobond, with AO Guta-Invest and AFK Sistema handling the sale in Russia, MGTS's financial adviser Guta-Invest said on Monday.

Final terms for the Eurobond will be determined after consultations with MGTS's legal advisers, Linklaters & Paines and Clifford Chance, it said in a joint statement from the four financial institutions.
Coopers & Lybrand is preparing an audit to international accounting standards of MGTS for 1995 and 1996, it said.

Proceeds from the bond will be used to finance the technical modernisation of OAO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (MGTS), including overlaying a digital network and setting up a modern system for metering local calls, it said.
